The company manufactures solar PV modules, including monocrystalline, HJT, and TOPCON types, and provides comprehensive solar energy solutions such as solar panels, inverters, storage systems, solar street lighting, and solar water pumps for both on-grid and off-grid applications.

GICL.NS.d: Globe International Carriers Limited provides logistics services in India and Nepal. These include industrial goods transport, bulk transport, door-to-door full truck loads, packing and unpacking, and surface cargo transportation, using four-, three- and two-wheelers as well as open and closed body vehicles.

HERANBA.NS.d: Heranba Industries Limited manufactures and markets a range of agrochemicals in India. The company engages in the research and development, manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of a range of crop protection chemicals, public health, and animal health solutions. It offers various pesticides, including insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and public health products for pest control. It also provides growth/spreader products, such as amino acids, gibberellic acid 0.001%L, and seaweed extracts.

IPCALAB.NS.d: Ipca Laboratories Limited manufactures and markets pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for various therapeutic segments in India. The company offers APIs in therapeutic areas of anti-hypertensive, anti-malarial, diuretic, DMARD, and anthelmintic.

KOTAKBANK-BL.NS.d: Kotak Mahindra Bank is a private sector bank offering a wide range of banking and financial services. These services include personal banking, corporate banking, investment banking, and wealth management. The bank is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

KOTYARK.NS.d: Kotyark Industries Ltd. makes and sells biodiesel and by-products in India, and also supplies crude glycerin. Its customers include oil marketing companies, commercial transport, industry and bulk buyers, and it sells through mobile retail outlets under the Green N Green brand. Incorporated in 2016, it is based in Vadodara.

LODHA.NS.d: Macrotech Developers Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and development of residential and commercial real estate properties in India and the United Kingdom. Its residential portfolio includes affordable, mid-income, and premium and luxury housing projects; and commercial portfolio comprises office and retail projects. The company also develops logistics and industrial parks.

LOTUSEYE.NS.d: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute Limited, an eye hospital, provides eye care services in India. It offers services in the areas of refractive surgery, retina and uvea, cornea, glaucoma, paediatric and squint, orbit and oculoplasty, and neuro ophthalmology, as well as binocular vision. The company also provides cataract and intraocular lenses, as well as operates an eye bank.

MEDIASSIST.NS.d: Medi Assist Healthcare Services is a company in health technology and insurance technology that offers TPA (third-party administration) services to insurers. It acts as an intermediary between insurers and policyholders, insurers and healthcare providers, and government and public health scheme beneficiaries, processing claims and handling policy administration and network management.

MILKYMIST.NS.d: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd. produces and supplies dairy goods such as cheese, paneer, butter, curd, ghee, yogurt, ice cream and UHT milk. It also sells ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook foods, chocolates, condensed milk, Indian sweets and beverages including lassi, milkshakes and flavored Greek yogurt and skyr.

MODISONLTD.NS.d: Modison Limited makes and supplies electrical contacts worldwide for switchgear at low, medium and high voltage. Mumbai is its headquarters, and it was founded in 1965. Its low voltage range includes silver-based contacts such as silver tin oxide, silver tungsten and silver tungsten carbide, supplied in solid, bimetal or backed forms, along with silver brazing alloys, powders and graphites.

NECCLTD.NS.d: North Eastern Carrying Corporation Limited provides transportation and logistics services in India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh. The company books small parcels, as well as full truck load, project, and over dimensional consignments. It also offers containerized movement of cargo, packing and moving, warehousing, and third party logistics and storage facilities. The company operates through a network of approximately 250 branches. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Delhi, India.

NITINSPIN.NS.d: Nitin Spinners Limited manufactures and sells cotton yarns and knitted fabrics in India. The company offers open end, multifold open end, ring spun combed, multifold ring spun, compact ring spun combed, multi-fold compact ring spun, fancy slub, compact fancy slub, core spun, compact core Spun, S and Z twist, organic cotton, contamination free, zero and eli twist, and certified yarns, as well as dye able cheese/cones used in woven and knitted apparel, furnishing fabrics, denims, terry towel, medical fabrics, tea…

NTL.NS.d: Neueon Towers Limited manufactures and trades in iron and steel products in India and internationally. The company offers galvanized steel products. It also manufactures various telecom/transmission and power towers, as well as TSF products. The company was formerly known as Sujana Towers Limited and changed its name to Neueon Towers Limited in October 2016. Neueon Towers Limited incorporated in 2006 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

ODIGMA.NS.d: Odigma Consultancy Solutions Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker ODIGMA and traded in INR. Its country is India.

ONIXSOLAR.NS.d: Onix Solar Energy Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker ONIXSOLAR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

PFS.NS.d: PTC India Financial Services Limited provides financing solutions to companies with projects in the power sector and related areas across the entire energy value chain. The company provides debt assistance to projects in the energy value chain, such as generation, transmission, and distribution, as well as in fuel sources and related infrastructure; and invests in equities. It also offers fund based/non-fund based financial assistance in the form of debt or structured debt instruments.

PIGL.NS.d: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Ltd. provides EPC solutions for electrical requirements and manufactures control panels, electrical panels and electronic boards. Its offerings cover power and distribution transformers, high- and low-tension distribution panels, cable management, lighting, access control, uninterruptible power supplies and building management systems.

PNBHOUSING.NS.d: PNB Housing Finance Limited operates as a housing finance company in India. The company offers housing loans for the purchase, construction, repair, and renovation of houses/ flats/commercial properties, etc.; loans for commercial spaces; loans against property; loans for purchase of residential plots; loans for purchase, construction, and extension of dwelling units; home loans for nonresident Indians and persons of Indian origin; Unnati home loans; and credit linked subsidy scheme for economical weaker section,…

REPL.NS.d: Rudrabhishek Enterprises Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated urban development and infrastructure consultant in India. Its consultancy services include viability analysis, infrastructure services, urban planning and geographic information system, building and area design, building information modelling, structural engineering design, services design, project management and RERA consultancy, and strategic marketing advisory.

SANOFICONR.NS.d: Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India Limited is a Mumbai-based company founded in 2023 that sells fast-moving consumer healthcare products for allergy relief, well-being and pain management. Brands include Allegra, Combiflam, Avil, DePURA, Festal and Novalgin NU. It sells through distributors, wholesalers, hospitals, pharmacies and e-commerce, and its parent is Opella Healthcare Participations B.V.

SERVICE.NS.d: Service Care Ltd. is an Indian integrated business services provider specializing in facility management and staffing solutions. The company offers a range of services including workforce management, cleaning, maintenance, payroll, and recruitment. It primarily serves corporate and industrial clients across various sectors such as healthcare, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), manufacturing, and infrastructure nationwide.

SKIPPER.NS.d: Skipper Limited manufactures and sells engineering and polymer products in India. It operates through Engineering Products, Infrastructure Projects, and Polymer Products segments. The Engineering Products segment offers power transmission towers, transmission line monopoles, power distribution and lighting poles, mid steel and high tensile angles, fasteners, tower accessories, telecom towers, railway electrification structures, angles, channels, high mast poles, swaged poles, scaffoldings, and solar power systems.

SREEL.NS.d: Sreeleathers Limited engages in the wholesale and retail of footwear, and leather goods and accessories in India. It offers formal, canvas, and casual, as well as school shoes; chappals; sandals; and accessories, such as belts, wallets, bags, socks, and jewelry and watch boxes for men, women, and kids, as well as disposable PPE kits and masks. Sreeleathers Limited sells its products through its online shopping website.

SRM.NS.d: SRM Contractors Limited is an Indian engineering, construction and development company with three business areas: roads and highways construction, trading, and quarry mining. Its work includes roads, bridges, tunnels and slope stabilisation, and it also acts as a subcontractor.

SRTRANSFIN-Z6.NS.d: Sec Red NCD 9.3% Sr.IV represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, offering a fixed interest rate of 9.3% and belonging to Series IV of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

SURANAT&P.NS.d: Surana Telecom and Power Limited engages in the generation and sale of solar and wind energy, and trade of solar modules in India. The company operates a solar power generation plant with an installed capacity of 23 MW; and wind power generation plant with an installed capacity of 1.25 MW. It also manufactures jelly filled cables, solar photovoltaic modules, aluminum and alloy aluminum rods, optical fiber cables, joining kits, and CDMA mobile handsets.

TEAMGTY.NS.d: Team India Guaranty Limited is a Mumbai-based Indian non-banking financial company that does not accept deposits and offers investment solutions. It mainly places its own capital in secure debt instruments and eligible deposit schemes. Founded in 1989 as Times Guaranty Limited, it is set to adopt its current name in July 2025.

TVSSRICHAK.NS.d: TVS Srichakra Limited manufactures and sells two-wheeler, three-wheeler, and other industrial tires and tubes to original equipment and vehicle manufacturers in India. It offers motorcycle, scooter, moped, industrial pneumatic, loader service, skid steer, tractor, lawn and garden, farm, agro industrial, farm and implement, flotation, multipurpose, motor grader, compactor, road grader, earthmover, solid resilient, light truck, and sand tires. The company also exports its products.

VEEGALAND.NS.d: Veegaland Developers Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VEEGALAND and traded in INR. Its country is India.
